episodes.title: AI Pipelines, Creatine, and Goodbyes
episodes.description: Steven shows the fully automated video workflow he built with Claude, which turns one MOV file into transcripts, translations, captioned shorts, and Substack drafts. He also tests five cameras, talks about Gary Vee's one-topic-per-account approach and his first days on creatine, and remembers two people who died, urging listeners to reach out to old friends.

episodes.title: Back at the Lectern: Recordings, Speeches and AI
episodes.description: Back in Beijing after the National Day holiday, Steven talks about new classroom rules: students must record their group discussions and give two-minute talks instead of reading from their phones. He also covers the privacy costs of AI agents, his four-terminal editing setup, a possible October stock market drop and Facebook Muse.

episodes.title: Pricey Tacos, Easy Bonds
episodes.description: Steven visits Beijing's Juicy Taco Festival, where the tacos cost too much but the old friends made the trip worth it, and he talks about Beijing rents, foreign workers forced out of China by age rules, and editing his US trip videos. He ends with a plain-language explanation of why bond prices fall when yields rise.

episodes.title: National Day Special: 5,000 Years of China in Brief
episodes.titleZh: 国庆特辑：五千年中国速览
episodes.description: On National Day, Steven gives a personal tour of what "5,000 years of Chinese history" means, running from the Shang dynasty to China as the world's factory. Along the way he covers cities worth visiting, why "Hong Kong" and "Xianggang" sound so different, his favourite foods, and his girlfriend's claim that Marco Polo stole pizza from China.

episodes.title: From an Airport Bench to Lake Erie
episodes.description: Steven records from a Cleveland-area truck stop after a sleepless night on a Buffalo airport bench, a pricey walk-in car rental, and a day exploring Buffalo, dipping his feet in Lake Erie, and reaching Cleveland. He reflects on the costs of travel in America, his improvised travel style, and whether to stay for the air show or press on to Detroit.

episodes.title: Buffalo: Wings, Strangers, and a Closed Door
episodes.titleZh: 布法罗：鸡翅、陌生人与闭门羹
episodes.description: Steven records outside a Buffalo tavern and recounts a night in a traveling salesman's hotel room, a free manuscript museum, Buffalo wings at Gabriel's Gate, and being turned away from a charity house. He weighs pricey options for leaving town and asks whether anyone can really travel the U.S. this way, and he also meets a bartender who is learning Chinese.
